fields.body:
Four meetings, 9:00–11:00: Dr. Plescia and Dr. Hrapcak; leadership and IT (Easom, Jumpp, Goddard, Ferdinand, Gaines); the evaluation team (Pare-Alanda, Bishop, Lafua).

Agreed: Rashaud Senior supports the AI opportunity assessment and Jonathan Ong joins for a peer session; Alix Ferdinand is the client liaison. Both are recorded in the revised proposal (Oct 9).

First priorities named by leadership: encounter volume by provider; syphilis, HIV and cervical cancer screening with no missed positives; understanding why STI/HIV testing volumes trail neighboring districts.

Next: measure list from Dr. Hrapcak; DMI materials and presentation from the evaluation team; state report examples via Ms. Gaines; lab-interface question to VHN; interview scheduling.

fields.title: Kickoff working notes (private)
fields.body:
DMI: standing committee, mostly IT plus three members, meets every two months, voluntary; one success (environmental health, Brandon Leftwich). Has a data-needs assessment (~2 yrs old) and a data management guide. Evaluation team (Naida, Femi, Jared): targeted evaluation plans; SurveyMonkey for new-hire, hiring-manager and client-satisfaction surveys; Power BI, SharePoint, Forms, Lists, OneDrive, Excel; Azure status unknown.

Clinical: VHN has no lab interface (Quest); old UI, vendor says updatable. Ryan White gets some data from LabCorp and is considering Quest. No master clinician table; no volume by provider. STI and HIV testing reported lower than surrounding counties, cause unknown. Priorities: syphilis, HIV, cervical cancer, no missed positives. Susan has a list of required measures (TB etc.). VHN is a challenge for the TB clinic.

Constraints: state prohibits AI tools in Teams; leadership wary of exposing AI use to the state. Most data manual, not automated; multiple sources of truth; no auditing; need training and buy-in.

To do: email Naida (presentation, assessment, guide); email Susan (measure list, VHN contract); invoice Dorothy (#1113, $750); ask Dorothy for state reports; one-page liaison role for Alix; draft VHN lab-interface request for Susan/Dwayne review; schedule Jonathan's session; add Goddard's title.
